reasons: 12 reviews read like search ads, using the bare search term with a place or repeating the business's name with its area.

chatbot_text.name: Chatbot or template text
chatbot_text.explain: Contains a phrase only a chatbot or an unfilled template produces, such as “I'm unable to generate a review” or “[Hotel Name]”.

copied_text.name: Copied text
copied_text.explain: Near-identical to a review that another account wrote.

keyword_style.name: Written like a search ad
keyword_style.explain: Uses the bare search term with a place (“best packers and movers in [area]”), or names the business with its area again and again, the way search-ranking copy is written. Several accounts here do it.

review_burst.name: Part of a burst of same-star reviews
review_burst.explain: Posted within a few hours or days together with many other reviews of the same rating (all 5★, or all 1★): a quarter or more of the newest reviews, far faster than this listing usually gets any.

linked_group.name: Linked reviewer group
linked_group.explain: The reviewer belongs to a group of accounts that reviewed the same unrelated businesses in distant cities.

review_spree.name: Reviewing spree
review_spree.explain: The reviewer rated many unrelated businesses in several cities within a month, nearly all 5★: the shape of “rate and earn” tasks, though some travellers review this way too.

names_area.name: Names the business with its area
names_area.explain: Names the business together with its neighbourhood or city, as many reviews at this listing do. Customers refer to a business this way too, so on its own it isn't a warning sign.

first_time_account.name: First-time account
first_time_account.explain: The account shows no other reviews. Many real customers create an account just to leave one review, so this alone isn't a warning sign.

evidence.text: 12 reviews read like search ads (“packers and movers in kothrud pune”), and 12 of the 64 reviews with text name the business or its category together with its neighbourhood or city. Customers do name a place that way; search-ranking copy repeats it.

caveats: This is a pattern, not proof.
Only the newest 64 reviews and the 10 highest-priority reviewers were examined.
Dates in reviewer histories are approximate.
Rings within a single city aren't detected.
Google may already have removed some reviews.
A business can be targeted without its knowledge: review-task scams hand recruits real businesses to review.
